projects.title: Access Control System
projects.description:
Capstone Project: The Project consist in a Three Layer Authentication Control System. That will prioritize security ensuring that the personal entering the desired location is actually allow to enter. This was achieved implementing:
- Keypad
- RFID Card
- Biometric Sensor
Using a Arduino Mega and C++ we created a code that will authentic the user only when they fulfill our three requirements matching the PING, RFID CARD and Fingerprint. Once the user meet the requirements the LCD Screen will display Access Granted and the servo motor will open the door. If user don't meet the requirements the LCD Screen will display Access Denied and the servo motor will not open.
